title: Now you can connect even more of your favorite apps and services to Gemini.
gist: A short Google product announcement from Made by Google (12 Aug 2026) that Gemini is adding third-party app connectors over the following weeks across productivity, local/entertainment, music, and home/health - naming Granola, Otter.ai, Wix, Fever, GetYourGuide, Localiza, OpenTable (UK), Ticketmaster, iHeartRadio, Pandora, Angi, Thumbtack, and Zocdoc. The signal is Gemini being positioned as a transaction and booking surface rather than a pure chat interface.

insights.claim: Google announced at Made by Google on 12 August 2026 that a new slate of third-party connected apps is coming to Gemini, rolling out over the next few weeks across productivity, local/entertainment, music, and home/health categories.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: Connector breadth is the moat metric for assistant platforms - track the cadence of partner additions as a proxy for Gemini's ecosystem pull.
insights.quote: Today at Made by Google, we’re announcing that a new slate of connected apps are coming to Gemini to help you get more done.

insights.claim: The named launch partners are Granola, Otter.ai, Wix, Fever, GetYourGuide, Localiza, OpenTable (UK), Ticketmaster, iHeartRadio, Pandora, Angi, Thumbtack, and Zocdoc - mid-cap and private consumer services rather than the largest incumbents in each vertical.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: Smaller platforms are trading distribution to Google first; the absent giants signal where negotiating leverage still sits.
insights.locator: Over the next few weeks, we’re rolling out

insights.claim: The connectors are framed around completing transactions - booking local experiences, renting a car, reserving dinner, buying event tickets, and booking a doctor's appointment - not merely retrieving information.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: If Gemini becomes the booking entry point, partner apps lose the discovery surface where they monetise ads and upsell.
insights.quote: Book local experiences, rent a car, reserve your next dinner, and search for event tickets

insights.claim: Google is positioning Gemini as a single consolidation surface where users plan, create, and clear their to-do list in one place, which is a direct claim on time currently spent inside individual apps.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: Engagement consolidation into one assistant is the bear case for standalone consumer app DAUs over the next few years.
insights.quote: you can easily plan, create, and tackle your to-do list all in one place
insights.locator: By turning on your favorite services

insights.claim: Coverage is geographically uneven - OpenTable is limited to the UK while Localiza is a Brazil-centred car rental brand - indicating partner integrations are being negotiated market by market rather than globally.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: Per-market rollout friction means assistant-driven booking volumes ramp slower than headline partner counts suggest.
